title: J. M. W. Turner's birth chart
metaDescription: J. M. W. Turner's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 3.1° Taurus. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Five of the ten placements whose signs are settled fall in earth signs — at least half of what the unknown hour leaves certain. An earth emphasis reads as patience with material reality — slow hands, durable results.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: Taurus, but precisely: 3.1°, first decan, 0°–10°, under Venus in the triplicity scheme. The tradition kept these divisions because thirty degrees is a long street.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: Mercury holds 6.1° Aries, Venus holds 28.9° Taurus, Mars holds 26.9° Leo — in the old shorthand, a mind that decides at speaking speed; taste for the substantial and the lasting; drive that ignites on contact.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The day's firmest angle joins Venus and Uranus — a conjunction holding at 1.9°. Two bodies in the same degree are not read as neighbours but as a merger: whatever one wants, the other is already funding. Behind it, Venus square Mars at 1.9°, and Venus trine Pluto at 2.1° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: Venus, Saturn, Pluto close a triangle of trines. The closed triangle is the scheme’s picture of flow — and its warning that flow, unspent, stays private. The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Of the seven planets the classical scheme judges, two sit in a sign it has an opinion about. Venus in Taurus at 28.9° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Saturn in Libra at 3.5° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best. None of these labels is a verdict on a person; they describe how a function is situated, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The honest balance sheet uses the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: earth 5, air 3, fire 2 across the elements, and fixed 5, cardinal 3, mutable 2 across the modalities. No settled placement falls in water — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Saturn and Neptune were retrograde — the optical reversal the tradition reads as review — energy turned over before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Aquarius for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 14.1° between midnight and midnight. Whatever the unrecorded hour was, it happened inside one Moon sign — the degree floats, the sign holds. At the noon reference it stands at 11.8°.
